parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the hybrid cloud cluster.
> This parameter applies only to hybrid cloud scenarios. You can call the [DescribeHybridCloudClusters](~~2849376~~) operation to query hybrid cloud cluster information.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query instance ID of the WAF instance.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 5. Default value: 5. This parameter is used for paging.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: RequestSensitiveTypeList
parameters.description: The list of request sensitive information types.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

parameters.name: ResponseSensitiveTypeList
parameters.description: The list of response sensitive information types.
